1.note:
One master takes one Manager, two or more take one Orchestrator; direct coordination is the developer-chosen exception.

Anchor: "The Architect's first delegation for one master"

2.note: Each independently falsifiable obligation gets a stable ID, version and canonical packet before topology.

3.note: A packet-named recorded invariant/family effect is declared by the Architect before implementation; no named effect means no declaration.

4.note: The authored source owns this contract; the distribution copy is not a separate authority.

5.note: Planning marks the Architect-only alignment, Prepared-context, effect-declaration and intent-review work explicitly, with all-role planning scope and permission boundaries outside that audience slice.

6.note: Before a new leaf starts, the Architect asks once for go or review first, discloses the planned comparison and first-Explain workspace, and records the choice; intent-review-open holds until go.

7.note: Before release, a reader other than the drafter compares a new or revised packet in both directions against every open leaf packet of its master, before the intent-review choice and again before go after review changes. Changed promises go to the developer; stale facts are fixed through registered revisions, and an issue stays in its original leaf unless another charter already covers it. Before any seat starts, Prepared context names record IDs/state, code/files/lines, unattributed callers and traps, including complete paged knowledge and the code it leaves unattributed. A packet adding a row, disposition, writer field or gate states how its own curation completes on the installed build; new behavior is proven on fixtures and scratch copies. Reported complete checks name included and excluded work, and pre-existing failures need same-cause base evidence. Under developer-chosen direct coordination, the Reviewer receives its exact bound intake first; plan/super-exit reviews have no startable seat and go through the Architect. The Architect reports an hour-long small item or a second repair round/freeze that day with a proposal to bound it. A UI fix is called working only after observation on the developer installation; otherwise it is landed and not verified there. At a handover or held/full-store result, the named message-handover detail owns sender and receipt handling.
